plan: With a private value of $25, I want to maximize potential profit. Since values are uniformly distributed between $0-$49, rational bidders will likely bid strategically around their private values. My optimal strategy is to bid slightly above my value but not so high that I risk negative earnings. I'll aim to bid around $30 - high enough to increase win probability but not so high that I risk overpaying if my value is only $25.

My value is $3, which is quite low. Since values are uniformly drawn between $0-$49, rational bidders will likely bid strategically near their true value. I want to minimize my risk of overpaying. Given the low personal value, I'll bid slightly below my true value to avoid paying more than the item is worth to me. A bid around $2-$3 seems reasonable, as it signals my low interest while giving a small chance of winning if others have similarly low values.

With a private value of $26, I want to win only if the price is below my value. Since values are randomly drawn between $0-$49, other bidders likely have values near mine. A dominant strategy is to bid slightly below my value to ensure profit if I win. I'll bid $24.90 - just under my value but high enough to have a good chance of winning while protecting potential profit margin.
